document_summary: A one-off project proposal from Fieldstone Studio for Rosewood Home Goods, covering an E-commerce build (up to 100 products) with two selected add-ons (copywriting and basic SEO setup), a phase/milestone table, an add-on menu with selected and unselected options, an itemised investment table with bundle discount and total, a 50/50 payment schedule, and proposal validity dates.

variables.description: Name of the prospective client the proposal is prepared for; appears in the proposal header and in the introductory prose.
Date until which the quoted pricing and terms remain valid.
Number of days the proposal remains valid, shown in parentheses after the validity date.
The fixed package chosen for this project; drives the scope heading, the base-fee line item label and the base template summary.

variables.sample_text: You reached out about moving Rosewood Home Goods into e-commerce — roughly 60 products, wanting product copy written for you and basic SEO set up rather than handling both in-house. That's a clean fit for our E-commerce template, with two add-ons layered in below. Here's exactly what happens, phase by phase, and what it costs.
variables.description: Opening prose describing this client's situation, why the recommended template fits, and which add-ons were layered on. Rewritten for every lead.

paragraph_config.purpose: Introduce the client's stated needs (their product count, the work they want done vs. handled in-house) and confirm the recommended package plus the add-ons selected.

variables.description: Number of products to be loaded/migrated; appears in the intro prose and in the build phase deliverable.

variables.sample_text: Base template: up to 100 products, Shopify or custom cart, typical delivery in 4–6 weeks.
variables.description: One-line summary of what the chosen base template includes (limits, cart options, typical timeline). Tier-dependent, so it is rewritten when the package changes.

paragraph_config.purpose: Summarize the standard inclusions and typical delivery timeline of the selected base template as sold to this client.

variables.sample_text:
**✓** Copywriting — product & category page copy written for you ($600)
**✓** Basic SEO Setup — metadata, sitemap, on-page basics ($450)
**○** *CMS Integration — not needed, Shopify's built-in CMS covers this*
**○** *Extra Revision Round — not selected, 1 round already included*
**○** *Rush Delivery — not selected, standard 4–6 week timeline confirmed*
variables.description: The full add-on menu block with ✓ marks on the add-ons chosen for this client and ○ on the ones declined, each with a short reason. Fully rewritten per client.

paragraph_config.purpose: Present the entire add-on menu, marking selected options with ✓ (with their prices) and unselected options with ○ plus a brief client-specific reason each was not selected.
paragraph_config.length_guideline: one line per add-on, 5 lines total

variables.natural_name: Base template price for selected tier
variables.description: Base fee for the chosen package/tier, shown on the first line item of the investment table.
Sum of the selected add-ons before any bundle discount.
Percentage discount applied to the add-on subtotal when two or more add-ons are selected.
Dollar amount of the bundle discount taken off the add-on subtotal; only applies when two or more add-ons are selected.
Final total project price after add-ons and bundle discount.

variables.sample_text: *No sales tax applies to this engagement under our standard services treatment.*
variables.description: Note below the investment table stating the sales-tax treatment for this engagement, which depends on the client's jurisdiction and the nature of the services.

paragraph_config.purpose: State the sales-tax treatment that applies to this engagement given the client's location and the services sold.
